The Power in the Lake Episode · Elyos · Lv. 5

Episode

The Power in the Lake is an Episode quest in AION 2 for Elyos characters around level 5. Below are its 2 steps and what it pays out. Daminu (Elim) gives the quest in Poeta. It follows Withered Tree Daminu and leads into Fledgling Wings.

The Elim Daminu warmly welcomed you. You must prove yourself through a trial and once again become a true Daeva.

Quest dialogue

14 lines of in-game dialogue from The Power in the Lake. Main speakers: Daminu and Asahr.

  1. DaminuHow long has it been, since a Daeva last sought me out...
  2. Hmm... quite unique, you are. A Daeva, but without any Daeva powers...
  3. There is no need to explain. You must have gone through a lot. Poeta is in little better a state...
  4. Daeva, deprived of your divinity... Will you seek ascension once again?
  5. Will you attain enlightenment of Odyle and become one who carries out AION's will?
  6. Enter the lake when you are ready... The Lake Guardian will test you.
Show the remaining 8 lines
  1. This is nostalgic... Poeta used to be bustling with visiting Daeva seeking me out for their ascension...
  2. You could very well be the last Daeva to ascend in Poeta...
  3. I wish you luck.
  4. AsahrFragment of AION... This is the Ascension Subspace.
  5. A proving ground for your ascension.
  6. I am AION's ego and your guide. I will lead you on the path of Ascension.
  7. Now, you shall take your first step to becoming an Arch Daeva.
  8. Reawaken your true strength as a Daeva, previously forgotten.

The Power in the Lake FAQ

How do I start The Power in the Lake?

The Power in the Lake unlocks at level 1 for Elyos characters and is recommended around level 5. Daminu (Elim) gives the quest in Poeta.

Where do I turn in The Power in the Lake?

Turn The Power in the Lake in to Asahr in Poeta.

What does The Power in the Lake reward?

The Power in the Lake gives 2,959 EXP and Kina (Bound) and Lesser Daeva Wings (Bound); the reward table lists every item and amount.

What quest comes after The Power in the Lake?

Completing The Power in the Lake unlocks Fledgling Wings.

Who do you talk to in The Power in the Lake?

The Power in the Lake has 14 lines of dialogue. The main speakers are Daminu and Asahr. It opens with: “How long has it been, since a Daeva last sought me out...”

What are the steps of The Power in the Lake?

The Power in the Lake has 2 steps, starting with: Enter Clione Lake Cave. The step list above shows each one in order.
